title: 1702-Q: Edit after Validate opens Schedules 1, 2 and 4 for every ATC
about: When you picked an ATC, BIR's 1702-Q (2018) opened Schedules 1, 2 and 4 whatever the ATC was. But Edit after Validate reopened them only for the regular-rate ATCs. With a special rate or exempt ATC (such as IC030 10% or IC011 0%) Schedule 4, the tax credits and payments, stayed greyed out after Edit. Edit now reopens the same boxes for every ATC, as picking the ATC does.
